baseline.historical_j9_attempt: the modal full-basis route failed at 108 free DOFs with aggregate_work_budget; the separate direct-only result remains unchanged

hypothesis: Newmark temporal error can be measured consistently across four TET10 meshes when the same force-time function, observation horizon, physical load point, physical measurement point and time grids are used on every mesh.

model.mesh_generation: structured rectangular cells split into six conforming tetrahedra per cell; shared midside nodes by unordered corner-edge pair
model.boundary_conditions: all UX, UY, UZ fixed on the complete x=0 face

load.type: 1 N negative-Z nodal force at the exact x=L face center (2,0.2,0.2) m
load.time_function: f(t)=0 at t=0; linear to -1 N at 1 ms; linear to zero at 2 ms; zero afterward

primary_probe.reason: fixed physical midspan center, away from the point load

secondary_probe.use: external-work indicator at the loaded node; spatially singular and not the primary mesh comparison

time_study.comparison_times: identical physical grid points for each time step and all meshes; no interpolation expected

temporal.operator: same per-mesh M and K assembled by GlobalAssembler from the same TET10 model
temporal.method: generalized symmetric eigendecomposition plus exact state transitions over affine force intervals; independent of the Newmark recurrence
temporal.scope: checks temporal integration only; does not verify spatial assembly against a continuum or an external solver

spatial.type: same-time response of each selected mesh compared against the finest selected mesh oracle
spatial.scope: descriptive mesh sensitivity only; not continuum error or a convergence qualification

references.external: Code_Aster and CalculiX are unavailable in the execution environment; no external correlation will be claimed

observables_and_indicators: midspan UZ history at a fixed physical coordinate
RMS and peak absolute difference from that mesh's semidiscrete oracle
RMS and peak differences normalized by one shared global oracle peak over all meshes at the finest time step
observed time-step refinement order, descriptive only
first semidiscrete frequency and mesh-to-mesh increments
assembled force resultant and positive TET10 corner volumes
post-pulse total-energy relative range and trapezoidal load-work versus final energy indicator

normalization.formula: RMS or peak absolute error divided by max absolute oracle midspan displacement across all four meshes at dt=0.000125 s
normalization.near_zero_handling: common nonzero global scale avoids local relative error blow-up at response zero crossings
normalization.thresholds: no formal acceptance threshold; values remain descriptive

execution.budget_semantics: timeout and captured-output caps are enforced by the launcher; RSS/process/temp/archive/free-space are sampled or soft controls, not OS quotas
execution.preflight: one exact-node pytest collect-only receipt required before the attempt

completion_invariants: positive TET10 corner volumes on every mesh
load point and midspan probe represented exactly on every mesh
same force-time function and 24 ms observation horizon
all direct histories finite and returned by the Newmark route
record the oracle and all differences without a numerical acceptance gate
